notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.notes:
• Fixed an unusual issue that could cause crashes when playing MIMIC.
• Corrected a bug where the dialogue selector would disappear when right-clicking, soft-locking the player.
• Fixed an error in one of Bighead's dialogue lines.
• Minor fixes.
• Moved a crow.

Thanks for reporting these bugs. We hope you're enjoying Lost Diskettes Vol. 1!

notes.title: Lost Diskettes Vol.1 is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[b]Lost Diskettes Vol.1 is OUT NOW![/b]

We are proud to announce that Lost Diskettes Vol.1 is now available on Steam.

Lost Diskettes is a collection of diverse experiences designed for players to take their time and reflect on what they are witnessing.

Each experience is unique. In some, you’ll find the absurd, the surreal, horror, and comedy. Some are visually grotesque, while others are not as much. It’s important to pay attention to these stories because, in most cases, they feature multiple endings depending on your choices.

We hope you enjoy playing Lost Diskettes Vol.1 as much as we enjoyed developing it. If you do, we’d greatly appreciate it if you left a review, as it helps us get our games noticed.

A special thank you to our patrons who made this project possible.

Best regards,
Puko
